acf.speaker_position: journalist, author of “Girls Gone Tech” blog

blocks.html: Karolina is a radio and press journalist and the author of the “Girls Gone Tech” blog. Currently, she publishes and reads news on Radio Złote Przeboje (Agora SA). She also runs a blog and a related fan page on Facebook devoted to the history of women in science and technology, and she published her first book "Cyfrodziewczyny" - a reportage about the female pioneers of Polish IT.
